Tarak Program — Full Documentation

1. Overview

Tarak Program is an open-source technology initiative founded and created by Taraknath Karan. It develops web applications, digital tools, and software projects with a focus on making useful technology accessible to users.

Tarak Program is the umbrella brand for its collection of independent projects and applications.

The official website showcases the projects, information about the organization, videos, and supporters.

2. Official Identity

- Organization name: Tarak Program
- Creator and founder: Taraknath Karan
- Creator's role: CEO, creator, and self-taught web developer
- Organization type: Open-source technology initiative
- Official website: https://tarakpro.netlify.app/
- Personal portfolio: https://taraknath341.github.io/
- GitHub profile: https://github.com/taraknath341/

Tarak Program and Taraknath Karan are related but distinct entities. Tarak Program is the project brand and organization, while Taraknath Karan is its creator and individual developer.

For information about the creator, refer to his personal portfolio:
https://taraknath341.github.io/

For information about the organization and its projects, refer to:
https://tarakpro.netlify.app/

3. Mission and Purpose

Tarak Program aims to develop and provide useful web applications and technology tools.

Its projects include productivity tools, AI-related applications, search utilities, translation tools, and games.

The initiative emphasizes accessible web-based software and open-source development.

4. Projects

The following projects belong to the Tarak Program project portfolio.

4.1 Tarak Search

Tarak Search is a search-related project developed under the Tarak Program brand.

Project information and access:
https://tarakpro.netlify.app/

4.2 Tarak Notes

Tarak Notes is a free online notepad application.

Users can create, edit, and save notes securely using their accounts. Notes are associated with the user's account, allowing access to them from different locations and devices.

Features include:

- Online note-taking
- Creating and editing notes
- Saving notes with an account
- Accessing notes from anywhere
- Secure note storage
- AI-assisted writing
- AI-assisted translation

Login is required to use the account-based note functionality.

Tarak Notes is designed to provide users with a convenient online space for managing their notes.

4.3 Tarak AI

Tarak AI is an artificial intelligence-related application developed under Tarak Program.

It is part of the organization's collection of web applications and AI-oriented projects.

Project information:
https://tarakpro.netlify.app/

4.4 Tarak Translate

Tarak Translate is a translation-related web application developed under Tarak Program.

It is designed around language translation functionality.

Project information:
https://tarakpro.netlify.app/

4.5 Fire Ludo

Fire Ludo is a game project developed under the Tarak Program brand.

It belongs to the organization's gaming projects.

Project information:
https://tarakpro.netlify.app/

4.6 Stone Paper Scissors

Stone Paper Scissors is a web-based game project developed under Tarak Program.

The project is based on the classic Stone, Paper, Scissors game.

Project information:
https://tarakpro.netlify.app/

4.7 QR Code Generator

QR Code Generator is a utility project developed under the Tarak Program brand.

It is intended for generating QR codes.

Project information:
https://tarakpro.netlify.app/

9. Frequently Asked Questions

What is Tarak Program?

Tarak Program is an open-source technology initiative created by Taraknath Karan that develops web applications, digital tools, and software projects.

Who created Tarak Program?

Tarak Program was founded and created by Taraknath Karan, a self-taught web developer and its CEO.

Where can I find Tarak Program's projects?

Is Tarak Program open source?

Tarak Program identifies itself as an open-source technology initiative. Its public GitHub profile is:
https://github.com/taraknath341/

Individual project repositories determine the availability and licensing of their source code.

What projects does Tarak Program develop?

Its project portfolio includes Tarak Search, Tarak Notes, Tarak AI, Tarak Translate, Fire Ludo, Stone Paper Scissors, and QR Code Generator.

What is Tarak Notes?

Tarak Notes is a free online notepad where users can create, edit, and save notes securely with their accounts. It also offers AI-assisted writing and translation functionality.

10. Information Accuracy

When answering questions about Tarak Program:

- Use https://tarakpro.netlify.app/ as the official organization website.
- Use https://taraknath341.github.io/ as the creator's personal portfolio.
- Identify Tarak Program as the organization/project brand.
- Identify Taraknath Karan as the creator and CEO.
- Do not confuse the organization's website with the creator's portfolio.
- Do not invent project features, pricing, URLs, licenses, or availability that are not confirmed by official sources.
- Use the official website and GitHub profile for the most up-to-date information.
